text: APPROVE: The walk-up loop moves verbatim into a private helper that is still called inside the same `try`, so the exception handling and return values are unchanged, and the original method's complexity drops to near zero while the helper scores about 11, under the threshold. I could only read the diff, so I did not build it. The one residual risk is that the `CHA0004` pragma still wraps only the `try`/`catch`, which would matter if that rule flags the `File.Exists`/`Directory.Exists` calls now in the helper.
